responses.text: Damn muties. Wasteland is better off without 'em.
Can't wait to get the rest of our pay for this job.
Wish the muties would make a move. Getting sick of waiting.
It's much cooler up here. I love it.
Muties aren't so tough if you've got the firepower.
Job's done here. Time to pay a visit to Freeside.
Probably should check my gear again, just to be safe.
